1929.body:
"Cheers 2027" is down to sixteen top prizes after a $20,027 winner was claimed in today's numbers. The game started with seventeen top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

If "Cheers 2027" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
1929.headline: Top prize count went down
